title: Do not laugh at another’s turn
odia:
ଉପର ବରଡ଼ା ଖସୁଛି,
ମଝି ବରଡ଼ା ହସୁଛି 
ତଳ ବରଡ଼ା କହୁଛି,
ମୋ ଦିନ କାଳ ଯାଉଛିରେ ଭାଇ ତୋ ଦିନକାଳ ଆସୁଛି ॥
literal_meaning: The upper leaf falls; the middle leaf laughs; the lower leaf says, “My time is passing, brother; your time is coming.”
explanation: The speaking leaves place laughter beside the passing of time. Read cautiously, the verse warns against treating another’s decline as something that can never reach oneself.
meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ ପତ୍ର ଖସୁଛି, ଆଉ ଗୋଟିଏ ହସୁଛି, ତୃତୀୟଟି ନିଜ ପାଳିର କଥା ମନେ ପକାଉଛି। ଅନ୍ୟର ଅବନତିକୁ ନିଜଠାରୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଦୂରର କଥା ଭାବିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ। ସମୟ ସହ ଅବସ୍ଥା ବଦଳେ ବୋଲି ମନେ ରଖିଲେ ଅନ୍ୟର ଦୁଃଖକୁ ନେଇ ହସିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଟିକେ ଅଟକିହେବ।
usage_example: Younger colleagues mock a retiring worker until they consider their own eventual retirement. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: No explanatory gloss accompanies this verse. The sequence of upper, middle and lower leaves is retained exactly; no botanical species, original voice or corrected sequence is asserted.
